execution: decide at close, fill at next open, long-only, no leverage
hypothesis: Chip-equipment makers (AMAT, LRCX, KLAC) and the SMH semiconductor ETF react to capex plans before memory demand shows up in memory-maker prices. When most of these leaders trade above their own long trend, memory names (MU, WDC, STX) that are also above their own trend should keep rising for days to weeks. When the leaders lose their trend, capex expectations are weakening and the memory names are left in cash.
rules: At each daily close, a leader (AMAT, LRCX, KLAC, SMH) is 'in uptrend' if its close is above its trailing leader_trend-bar simple average (current close included).
The leader basket is 'confirmed' when at least min_leaders of the 4 leaders are in uptrend.
A memory name (MU, WDC, STX) is eligible when the basket is confirmed AND its close is above its own stock_trend-bar simple average.
Sizing: each eligible memory name gets an equal 1/3 of capital; non-eligible slots stay in cash. Leaders are signal-only (weight 0). No shorts, no leverage.
Decide at the close, fill at the next open. No hysteresis or minimum holding period.
